Maya: Morning all — quick check on the rail. Cut window in 45m. Patch queue down to 3 PRs. I pushed a hotfix for model routing (PR #4821) and triggered a canary. Observability shows 95th latency back to ~190ms. No blockers from my side.
Rob: Seeing a transient CI lint failure on the canary job (grpc module). I retriggered the job. @Jin can you take a look at #4821 when you get a sec? :eyes: 
Jin: On it — lint is flaky import-order in transformer tests. I'll rebase and force-push; should clear. Also we need a GPU swap for canary-2 to test large-batch config, pinging eng-infra.
ReleaseBot: Canary deploy started for train-2026-03-17-candidate-5 — 10% traffic, instances in us-west-2. Logs: https://rwd.logs/canary/3345678901
Elaine: Heads-up: cherry-pick request from #4799 contains a DB migration. Migration window unavailable before cut (conflicts with nightly backups). Blocker unless we postpone or run migration out-of-band.
Maya: Good catch. Let's hold #4799 for the next slot. Can we instead cherry-pick the non-migration parts (auth fix + tests)?
Rob: We can extract the auth fix into #4830, small and low-risk. I'll open it now and tag for a fast review.
Jin: Rebase pushed for #4821, rerunning CI. If green I'll LGTM and merge shortly.
Elaine: Also FYI canary perf: memory spikes on replica-3 at 03:12 UTC — telem shows KV cache warmup. Not blocking but keep an eye.
Maya: Perfect. Action items: Rob -> open #4830, Jin -> finish CI + merge #4821, Elaine -> monitor replica-3 and report if it regresses, Maya -> hold #4799. Ping here when tasks done. :rocket:
